column1: # Flake quarantine for scripts/ci/testquarantine: import-path<TAB>test<TAB>#ticket.
# A row takes one test out of the GATING jobs of .github/workflows/tests.yml
# (test-unit, test-e2e, race-shard, test-native-exec skip it through
# `go test -skip`) and into the nightly advisory workflow
# .github/workflows/test-quarantine.yml, which runs exactly these tests under
# the gating flags (plain, then -race) and fails visibly when one fails.
# `test` is a `go test -run` path: slash-separated levels, each a regexp the
# tool anchors (^level$); letters, digits and `_ - . * + ? = : ,` only. The
# top level names a Test function of THIS package and of no other one — the
# gating -skip is global to a `go test` invocation, so a name shared with
# another package would skip that package's test too (the tool's guard
# refuses it).
# Every row carries the OPEN ticket that owns the fix. Closing the ticket
# removes the row in the same change: the nightly job reads each ticket's state
# and fails on a closed or missing one.
